claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: Should the early availability check also cover non-pruned nodes? They can load a snapshot without having the historical block or undo data.
claims.request: Extend the early block/undo data availability check to non-pruned nodes to avoid copying the UTXO set before failing rollback

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: Would a more general error message describe these cases better? Specifically, changing: Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned. to: Could not roll back to requested height because required block or undo data is unavailable.
claims.request: Generalize the error message to state required block or undo data is unavailable rather than pruned

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: Could the boundary eventually compare the highest missing-data height against the target using `>` instead of `>=`? The loop in `CreateRolledBackUTXOSnapshot` uses: `while (block_index->nHeight > target->nHeight)`
claims.request: Compare the missing-data boundary against target height using > instead of >= to avoid rejecting valid rollbacks to the target height
